relationships.subject: CCL18
relationships.evidence_quote: CCL18 plays a role in endometriotic progression by increasing the migration of endometrial cells and promoting neuroangiogenesis

relationships.subject: ML604086
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking CCL18/CCR8 inhibited lesion development, angiogenesis and nerve fiber growth in endometriosis in vivo.

relationships.subject: CCL18
relationships.evidence_quote: CCL18 concentrations in the peritoneal fluid were positively correlated with the VA S score in the patients with and without endometriosis

key_findings: CCL18 is overexpressed in endometriotic lesions and peritoneal fluid, correlates with pain, and promotes endometrial cell migration, HUVEC tube formation and F11 DRG-cell neurite growth.
CCR8 antagonist ML604086 reduced lesion number, vessel density and nerve infiltration in a mouse endometriosis model.
